integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof with exact symbolic Lyapunov and coefficient verification; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to stationary additive linearized two-patch fluctuations with symmetric dispersal, fixed positive local return rates and arbitrary positive-semidefinite noise covariance. Neither nonlinear extinction nor population positivity follows; potentially equivalent prior covariance classifications remain a bibliographic risk.
title: No local-variance maxima under symmetric dispersal in a two-patch fluctuating population
